message: No update bot delays new versions of Cargo dependencies: the repository configures neither Dependabot nor Renovate, and Cargo before 1.100.0 has no release-age delay of its own (Cargo 1.100.0 adds registry.global-min-publish-age in .cargo/config.toml, which depcurfew does not configure), so nothing holds back the versions the dependencies in Cargo.lock and Cargo.toml are updated to
fix: Update these dependencies with Dependabot (an updates entry with package-ecosystem: cargo in .github/dependabot.yml) or Renovate (its cargo manager), then run depcurfew init and depcurfew apply, which give the bot a cooldown; depcurfew delays Cargo dependencies only through these bots
